description: Presentation-only map extents for the standalone OSM-versus-skeleton paper figures. These settings do not rewrite completed experimental run manifests.

malibu_ca.display_name: Malibu-Santa Monica Bay / North & West Los Angeles
malibu_ca.extent_note: A 35 km point-centered bounding footprint includes the full Malibu coast and Santa Monica Bay together with substantial northern and western Los Angeles. The regional-scale skeleton retains major OSM road classes so nodes and edges remain legible at paper scale.
